moduleSeedOrdinalFormula.indexRange: g and i are exact u32 values; bits 40..47 identify the module category and bits 56..63 remain reserved for sequenceKindU64

permutation.sequenceScope: independently permute each expanded module's imports, declarations, references, relations, and geometry list with that module's moduleSeedOrdinalU64; empty and singleton lists still use the same defined seed but perform no swap

stringProfiles.scope: LF-COMP-ID-v1 at B, calibration scale, stress scale
LF-COMP-ID-v1 at B, calibration scale, stress scale

candidateRegistry.selectionRule: evidence candidate IDs, key domains, seed policies and component bindings must match exactly one registry entry; unregistered or partially matched configurations are invalid
candidateRegistry.componentVersionRule: standard-library components bind environment.rustc, local-workspace components bind harnessCommit, and crates-io or git components bind the harness Cargo.lock package ID, version, features and checksum
candidateRegistry.baselineSelectionRule: candidate comparisons must use the exact baselineByKeyDomain entry, the candidate ID must differ from that baseline, and both IDs must be registered for the selected key domain

identityBindingExpansion.declarationLocalOrdinalDefinition: zero-based ordinal among declarations of the same entity kind inside one workload unit, assigned in canonical declaration construction order before any per-module declaration permutation
identityBindingExpansion.assignmentTiming: assign and retain declarationLocalOrdinalWithinKind before applying permutation.sequenceKinds.declarations; source traversal order and hash-table iteration never change it
identityBindingExpansion.multiFileCollectionRule: when one workload unit binds multiple source files, traverse workload.templateFiles or case.files in listed order, skip files without the named collection, and concatenate each matching sourceCollectionOrderByEntityKind traversal

sourceCollectionOrderByEntityKind.AuthoringLane: roadSections array order, then each road section lanes array order
sourceCollectionOrderByEntityKind.SignalPhase: signals.controllers array order, then each controller phases array order
sourceCollectionOrderByEntityKind.CanonicalFrame: the single synthetic canonical frame has ordinal 0

declarationOrdinalByWorkload.LF-COMP-ID-v1: every entity kind occurs exactly once per unit, so every declarationLocalOrdinalWithinKind is 0
declarationOrdinalByWorkload.LF-COMP-CORRIDOR-v1: use sourceCollectionOrderByEntityKind for the bound fixture template before unit replication; every replicated unit retains the same per-kind source ordinal
declarationOrdinalByWorkload.LF-COMP-RESEARCH-CURRENT-FIXTURES-v1: use sourceCollectionOrderByEntityKind independently for each case, with fixedFixtureUnitIndex=0

profiledKeyExpression.kindRule: K must equal the current identityBindings entityKindCode
profiledKeyExpression.localMeaning: S is the zero-based profiled-key field slot among the current identity binding fields in field order; it is not a declaration ordinal
profiledKeyExpression.profiledKeyFieldCountFormula: count fields whose value uses profiled-key in the current identity binding

expandedKeyFormulaByWorkload.LF-COMP-ID-v1: selected stringProfiles[].profiledKeyFormula with kindCode=current entity kind, unitIndex=current workload unit index, localIndex=expandedLocalIndex
expandedKeyFormulaByWorkload.LF-COMP-CORRIDOR-v1: short-unique-v1 profiledKeyFormula with kindCode=current entity kind, unitIndex=current workload unit index, localIndex=expandedLocalIndex
expandedKeyFormulaByWorkload.LF-COMP-JUNCTION-GRID-v1: short-unique-v1 profiledKeyFormula with kindCode=current entity kind, unitIndex=current workload unit index, localIndex=expandedLocalIndex
expandedKeyFormulaByWorkload.LF-COMP-RESEARCH-CURRENT-FIXTURES-v1: projectionContract.identityRule.profiledKeyFormula with entityKindCode=current entity kind and sourceArrayOrdinal=expandedLocalIndex

profiledKeyExpression.rangeRule: expandedLocalIndex must fit u32 and every (entityKindCode, unitIndex, expandedLocalIndex) tuple must be unique

stableIdExpression.localMeaning: R is the zero-based reference slot among references from the current declaration to target entity kind K; it is not the target declaration ordinal
stableIdExpression.targetRule: resolve the named reference slot below to exactly one target declaration, then use that declaration's fully computed StableId128

referenceResolutionByWorkload.LF-COMP-ID-v1: resolve the nine identity-defining ownerRelations plus the sole LaneEdge as both ManeuverPath entry and exit target; preserve the explicit ParkingSpace-to-ParkingArea relation without using it as an identity field
referenceResolutionByWorkload.LF-COMP-CORRIDOR-v1: resolve source IDs and the validated unique owner tree from each bound fixture template before unit replication; preserve optional ParkingSpace.areaId relations without using them as identity fields
referenceResolutionByWorkload.LF-COMP-RESEARCH-CURRENT-FIXTURES-v1: resolve source IDs and the validated unique owner tree independently inside each exact fixture case; preserve optional ParkingSpace.areaId relations without using them as identity fields

sourceReferenceExpansion.scope: every identity stable-id field, every StableId payload field, every moduleGraphProfiles cross-module reference, and every fixed-fixture spatial-to-traffic binding
sourceReferenceExpansion.targetModuleOrdinalRule: zero-based ordinal in researchStageModel.stringAggregateModel.canonicalModuleOrder or projectionContract.moduleOrder for fixed fixtures
sourceReferenceExpansion.spellingFormulaSource: researchStageModel.stringAggregateModel.sourceReferenceSpelling for scalable workloads and projectionContract.sourceReferenceRule for fixed fixtures
sourceReferenceExpansion.orderingRule: enumerate identity fields by canonical module order, entityKindCode, declarationLocalOrdinalWithinKind, then field tag; enumerate relation and geometry payload references by sourceSpanRule canonicalSequenceOrdinal then recordKinds.payloadFields order; enumerate cross-module bindings by moduleGraphProfiles listed order; assign source spans before reference permutation
sourceReferenceExpansion.validationRule: each spelling must resolve back to exactly the same target declaration or shared constant used to build the typed StableId/reference payload

researchStageModel.storageRule: one contiguous value buffer plus one contiguous payload byte buffer per stage; no per-record heap allocation
researchStageModel.recordOrder: moduleOrdinal, recordKindCode, sourceSpanOrdinal with absentOrdinalU32 first, entityKind, ownerLocalIndex, payloadBytes
payloadPartitionOrder: source spans or typed u32 operands as selected by the stage formula

stringAggregateModel.scope: all UTF-8 strings materialized in sourceInput, typedAst, or hir payload buffers; manifest metadata and sourceToken bytes are excluded
itemOrder: canonical module names in expanded module order
source document keys in expanded module order
import target canonical module names in expanded edge order
one namespace field string per identity declaration in declaration order
profiled identity key strings in declaration and identity-field tag order
source reference spellings in source reference order
shared constant name then shared constant value when present
stringAggregateModel.canonicalModuleOrder: root, shared/common when present, group/{g:08x} by g, unit/{i:08x} by i
stringAggregateModel.stringItemCountFormula: moduleCount + sourceDocumentCount + importEdgeCount + identityDeclarationCount + profiledKeyOccurrenceCount + sourceReferenceCount + graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.sharedConstantStringItemCount
stringAggregateModel.maximumStringBytesFormula: max(graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.maximumCanonicalModuleNameBytes, graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.maximumSourceDocumentKeyBytes, graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.maximumImportTargetModuleNameBytes, 32 when identityDeclarationCount > 0, stringProfile.profiledKeyLengthBytes when profiledKeyOccurrenceCount > 0, 30 when sourceReferenceCount > 0, graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.maximumSharedConstantStringBytes)

aggregateInputFormulas.semanticPayloadByteCount: sum exact payload byte lengths obtained from recordKinds, identityBindings, stringProfile, and the canonical records for this level

recordGranularity: one record per identity field occurrence
one record per source geometry point
typedAst.recordCount: moduleCount + importEdgeCount + sourceDeclarationCount + identityFieldOccurrenceCount + sourceReferenceCount + sourceRelationCount + sourceGeometryCount

recordGranularity: one record per identity field occurrence
one record per resolved source reference
one record per typed source relation
one record per unit-checked source geometry point
hir.recordCount: moduleCount + importEdgeCount + symbolCount + identityFieldOccurrenceCount + sourceReferenceCount + sourceRelationCount + sourceGeometryCount

mir.recordGranularity: one record per canonical semantic record before canonical sort and final owner-local ordinal assignment

canonicalLir.recordGranularity: one record per canonical semantic record after canonical sort and final owner-local ordinal assignment

diagnostics.logicalBytes: exact diagnostic stream record bytes excluding the diagnostic stream header

verificationRules: G2 must assert Rust repr(C) size_of for every research record layout before measurement
G2 generator and independent validator must separately enumerate aggregate inputs and evaluate every stage formula
stage record values and payload buffers must be materialized inside the measured pipeline
Rust padding, container capacity, allocator metadata, and process memory are measured separately and never added to logicalBytes

semanticRecordEnvelopeRules.ownerEntityRule: every v1 record kind has exactly one record-owning entity; entityKindU16Le and stableIdBytes16 identify that entity, never a referenced payload entity
semanticRecordEnvelopeRules.currentKindAbsenceRule: record kinds 1 through 13 require a nonzero entity kind, an exact owner stable ID and a present owner ordinal; only recordKinds[].envelopeBinding.localIndexSource may select absent-u32-max
semanticRecordEnvelopeRules.ownerOrdinalDerivation: sort all identity-declaration records with the same entityKindU16Le by stableIdBytes16 in unsigned lexicographic byte order; ownerOrdinalU32Le is the zero-based position of the record-owning entity
semanticRecordEnvelopeRules.ownerOrdinalCrossCheck: the tuple (entityKindU16Le, stableIdBytes16) must resolve to exactly one identity-declaration record and its recomputed same-kind ordinal must equal ownerOrdinalU32Le
semanticRecordEnvelopeRules.stableIdAbsenceRule: v1 has no absent stable-id sentinel; all sixteen bytes belong to the exact record-owning StableId128
semanticRecordEnvelopeRules.localIndexRule: payload-field means exact equality with that payload field; owner-collection-index means group records by the exact record owner after typed reference resolution, sort each named owner collection by final payloadBytes in unsigned lexicographic byte order, and assign zero-based consecutive indexes (equal payload copies remain consecutive and need no source-order tie break); absent-u32-max means exactly 4294967295

gateOccurrenceConstruction.occurrenceOrder: ascending transitionIndex, then maneuverGateStableIdBytes16 unsigned lexicographic
gateOccurrenceConstruction.occurrenceIndexFormula: zero-based position in occurrenceOrder for the owning ManeuverPath
gateOccurrenceConstruction.stopLineConstraint: the referenced StopLine belongs to orderedManeuverPathLaneEdgeStableIds[transitionIndex] and current v0.10 location edgeEnd

waitingZoneOccurrenceConstruction.occurrenceOrder: ascending entry gate transitionIndex, then release gate transitionIndex, then waitingZoneStableIdBytes16 unsigned lexicographic
waitingZoneOccurrenceConstruction.occurrenceIndexFormula: zero-based position in occurrenceOrder for the owning ManeuverPath
waitingZoneOccurrenceConstruction.fixtureCapacityFormula: exact positive source maxOccupancy converted to u32

diagnosticCodes.source: mutated second owner relation source span

diagnosticStream.canonicalRouteOccurrenceOrder: the canonical valid semantic record order restricted to record kind 4, before applying any failure input mutation

unknownLaneEdgeKeyEncoding.format: targetEntityKindCode lowercase hex width 2 || '/' || unitIndex lowercase hex width 8 || '/' || localIndex lowercase hex width 8

diagnosticStream.unknownLaneEdgeKeyRangeRule: mutatedRouteOccurrenceOrdinalWithinUnit is zero-based in canonical route-occurrence order, is less than 0x80000000, and every generated key is absent from the declaration table
diagnosticStream.canonicalOrderRule: sort all full diagnostic candidates lexicographically by canonicalOrderKey before applying maxDiagnostics; byte-identical ties need no source-order tie break
diagnosticStream.truncationRule: retain the first min(fullCandidateCount,maxDiagnostics) canonical diagnostics; diagnosticsTruncated is fullCandidateCount > maxDiagnostics
diagnosticStream.diagnosticLimitOutcomeRule: when truncationRule drops any candidate, stableCompilerErrorCode is LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-DIAGNOSTIC-LIMIT; that outcome code is not an emitted diagnostic and therefore has no typed payload record

inputVariantCandidateRules.corridor-missing-reference-per-unit-v1: one LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-UNKNOWN-REFERENCE candidate for the first canonical route occurrence in each unit
inputVariantCandidateRules.corridor-duplicate-owner-per-unit-v1: one LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-DUPLICATE-OWNER candidate for the first canonical FacilityBand in each unit after adding the second RoadCorridor owner
inputVariantCandidateRules.corridor-diagnostic-cap-plus-one-v1: N + 1 LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-UNKNOWN-REFERENCE candidates from the first N + 1 canonical route occurrences globally; apply maxDiagnostics=N

fixtureTemplateRules.nestedAuthoringLaneOrder: roadSections array order, then lanes array order
fixtureTemplateRules.referenceRemap: source ID resolves to entity kind and source array ordinal before timed execution

unitConstruction.movementOrder: entryDirection ascending, then exitDirection ascending excluding exitDirection == entryDirection
unitConstruction.movementIndexFormula: entryDirection * 3 + rank(exitDirection among allowed ascending exits)

projectionContract.scope: non-production research projection only; it does not define LF-COMP-CURRENT-EQUIV-v1 or a production frontend
moduleOrder: spatial when the selected case contains a SpatialPackage
projectionContract.moduleImports: spatial imports traffic exactly once when present; otherwise no imports

trafficEntitySources.AuthoringLane: roadSections array order then lanes array order
trafficEntitySources.SignalPhase: signals.controllers array order then phases array order

spatialEntitySources.canonicalGeometryPoint: join edges by trafficEdgeId to the traffic LaneEdge declaration, then enumerate centerline.points in traffic LaneEdge declaration order and point array order
spatialEntitySources.crossModuleReference: one spatial-to-traffic LaneEdge binding per joined spatial edge

relationSources.owner-relation: AuthoringLane nesting; Movement.junctionId; ManeuverPath.movementId; ManeuverGate.maneuverPathId; WaitingZone.maneuverPathId; SignalPhase controller nesting; ParkingSpace.areaId; LaneGroup.roadSectionId; RoadCorridor.elements ownership of RoadSection or FacilityBand
relationSources.edge-connection: laneGraph.edges array order then connections array order
relationSources.route-occurrence: routes array order then edgeIds array order
relationSources.access-relation: accessRules array order then participantClassIds array order
relationSources.signal-group-relation: signals.maneuverGates array order where signalControl.kind is group
relationSources.signal-phase-state: signals.controllers, phases, then states array order
relationSources.lane-coverage-occurrence: roadSections, lanes, then edgeIds array order
relationSources.junction-internal-edge-role: maneuverPaths array order then internalEdgeIds array order

identityRule.originalIdUse: resolve current fixture references outside the measured region, then discard original strings
identityRule.identityFields: apply identityBindings in ascending field tag order

sourceReferenceRule.countRule: identity stable-id fields plus every StableId payload field of the projected relation and geometry records plus spatial-to-traffic cross-module bindings

projectionContract.sourceRule: apply sourceSpanRule token ordering and byte lengths, substitute projectionContract.sourceDocumentKeyFormula, and apply researchStageModel to the exact case projection without N scaling
projectionContract.scenarioManifestRule: bind file identity and source lineage only; emit no module, declaration, reference, relation, geometry, semantic, or stage record
projectionContract.unlistedProductionSemantics: not-compared and forbidden from implicit projection

workloads.stageInputRule: apply projectionContract and the selected case projection exactly; compare every aggregate input, domain count, semantic payload byte count, and exactStageExpectation; current fixtures never enter budget or candidate ranking

compilerControlledLowerBound.fixedOverheadRule: no separate fixed-overhead term exists in protocol v1

guardPredictionContract.integerArithmetic: evaluate checked u128 products; compute ceiling division from quotient and nonzero remainder without numerator-plus-denominator-minus-one; convert the final result with u64::try_from
guardPredictionContract.candidateIndependenceRule: the lower bound is derived only from the bound manifest and selected workload level; candidates cannot add, subtract, or measure a private fixed-overhead value

candidateConfiguration.capacityPolicy: fresh process; checked exact lower-bound reserve request before each buffer/table; no stable-capacity reuse

liveByteLimitBaseline.selectedPrivateLimitMode: disable only compiler-controlled-live-byte-count; retain the operational controlled-allocation hard ceiling and every other private limit
liveByteLimitBaseline.agreementRule: the two valid replicas for the same workload/profile/N/B/scale stratum must report exactly equal peakLiveRequestedBytes
liveByteLimitBaseline.exactSelectedValueRule: the common peakLiveRequestedBytes value is the only exact selected value allowed for both paired limit runs in that stratum
liveByteLimitBaseline.candidateIsolationRule: the at-bound and plus-one pair reuses this same baseline candidate configuration; no evaluated candidate may supply its own limit value

inputVariants.construction: the selected canonical scalable workload level without semantic mutation
replace the first canonical route occurrence in every unit with an unknown LaneEdge; retain every record count and source position
attach the first canonical FacilityBand in every unit to the second RoadCorridor while retaining its first owner
replace the first N + 1 canonical route occurrences with independent unknown LaneEdges, set maxDiagnostics=N, and retain all other records
use the canonical N=1 corridor workload without semantic mutation and replace only the candidate hash builder with the qualification builder
at N=1 replace the first canonical route occurrence with the diagnosticStream unknown LaneEdge and replace only the candidate hash builder with the qualification builder

candidateRosterContract.entryOrderRule: candidateRegistry.candidates filtered by allowedKeyDomains containing stratum.keyDomain, preserving registry order
candidateRosterContract.rosterCompletenessRule: every filtered registry candidate appears exactly once; unregistered, omitted, duplicated or reordered entries are invalid
candidateRosterContract.baselineRule: baselineId equals candidateRegistry.baselineByKeyDomain[stratum.keyDomain]; exactly one entry has candidateId=baselineId; only that entry may use baseline-participant
candidateRosterContract.candidateCountRule: count entries whose disposition is baseline-participant or performance-participant
candidateRosterContract.minimumParticipantRule: a performance schedule requires C>=2 and exactly one baseline-participant; otherwise no candidate comparison may reference the roster

balancedScheduleRule.participantOrder: ordered subsequence of entries whose disposition is a participant disposition
balancedScheduleRule.forwardHalf: position j of round r is participant[(j+r) mod C] for r,j=0..C-1
balancedScheduleRule.reverseHalf: position j of round C+r is participant[(r-j) mod C] for r,j=0..C-1

candidateRosterContract.candidateComparisonReferenceRule: candidate comparison rosterId resolves uniquely; candidateId is a performance-participant, baselineId is the roster baseline-participant, and the comparison stratum projects to the roster stratum

limitPairConstruction.precondition: selected dimension exact value is at least one at calibration and stress scales; diagnostic-count uses the bound diagnostic-producing variant whose exact value is N
limitPairConstruction.atBound: use the canonical workload level and set the selected limit equal to its exact selected dimension value
limitPairConstruction.plusOne: reuse the same canonical workload level and set only the selected limit to exact selected dimension value minus one

selectedValueBasisRules.canonical-level-exact-value: all ordinary count/byte dimensions use the exact formula-derived value from the selected workload level
selectedValueBasisRules.diagnostic-input-count: diagnostic-count uses the exact N diagnostics produced by corridor-missing-reference-per-unit-v1
selectedValueBasisRules.baseline-live-byte-prescan-v1: compiler-controlled-live-byte-count uses only the common value from the two valid compiler-controlled-live-byte-baseline-v1 replicas for the same stratum

success-at-bound.plusOne: fail with stable compiler error LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-LIMIT-EXCEEDED and one diagnostic using the selected limitDimensions one-based dimensionCodeU8 before allocation, copy, sort, hash, or stage work prohibited by that limit

baseline-live-byte-prescan-v1.atBound: the frozen baseline candidate succeeds with maxCompilerControlledLiveBytes equal to the prescan common peakLiveRequestedBytes
baseline-live-byte-prescan-v1.plusOne: the same baseline candidate fails with stable compiler error LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-LIMIT-EXCEEDED and one compiler-controlled-live-byte-count diagnostic at the first reservation that would make simultaneous requested bytes exceed common peakLiveRequestedBytes - 1

diagnostic-cap-on-semantic-failure.atBound: compiler-error LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-UNKNOWN-REFERENCE with exactly N diagnostics and diagnosticsTruncated=false
diagnostic-cap-on-semantic-failure.plusOne: compiler-error LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-DIAGNOSTIC-LIMIT when emitting the Nth diagnostic against maxDiagnostics=N-1; retain exactly N-1 diagnostics, set diagnosticsTruncated=true, and start no later compiler stage

inputDigestIncludes: canonical ordered source value records and payload bytes after applying the input variant
selected value basis and any baseline measurement run IDs

failureCases.mutation: replace the first canonical route occurrence in every unit with an unknown LaneEdge
attach the first canonical FacilityBand in every unit to a second RoadCorridor
set maxDiagnostics=N and create N+1 independent unknown references

baselineCleanupObservationContract.experimentOrder: cleanupExperimentBindings array order, then each binding scaleRoles array order
baselineCleanupObservationContract.scaleSourceFixedCaseIdRule: scaleSource.caseId must equal not-applicable; caseId is a fixed source precondition and is excluded from the baseScales projection because baseScales entries do not carry a caseId field
baselineCleanupObservationContract.scaleSourceBResolutionRule: project scaleSource to scaleSourceIdentityFields, resolve exactly one baseScales entry matching that projection, require a non-null selected b.value, then derive calibration/stress N from scaleSelectionContract for that same entry
baselineCleanupObservationContract.sequenceRule: exactly sequenceIndex 0, 1..32, 33 and 34 with no omission or duplicate
baselineCleanupObservationContract.instanceRule: sequence 0..33 uses one compilerInstanceId; sequence 34 uses a different newly issued compilerInstanceId
baselineCleanupObservationContract.groupIdentityRule: experimentId is unique and every run has the same candidate, workload, graph/string profile, generator, selected B, derived scale N and failure case required by its cleanupExperimentBinding
failureIterationPassRules: actual outcome, stable compiler error, diagnostic count, truncation and partial output match the bound failure case
metrics.liveRequestedBytes.value equals zero after every failure iteration
metrics.retainedCapacityBytes.value for sequence 2..32 is less than or equal to the value at sequence 1
baselineCleanupObservationContract.recoveryPassRule: sequence 33 and 34 match in outcome, stage record counts, semantic digest, diagnostic digest, stable compiler error state and partial output record count
baselineCleanupObservationContract.groupPassRule: all sequence, identity, failure-iteration and recovery rules pass; missing or invalid observations fail the group
baselineCleanupObservationContract.scopeRule: all six groups are baseline lifecycle observations; they do not qualify, reject or recommend a private candidate and do not alter candidateDecisionContract performance classifications
baselineCleanupObservationContract.formalLadderExclusionRule: every cleanup run uses roundAttempt.scope=single-experiment and is excluded from round summaries, ladder summaries, knees, reproducibility envelopes, growth slopes, candidate comparisons and budget recommendations
